evidence: rows_column_scanner.go; inherited RowsScan and typed/RawBytes benchmarks

name: native binary bulk execution
evidence: Opt-in BulkExec; real 1/16/100/1000-row tests, unsigned/NULL/DEFAULT/IGNORE, errors and validation-before-send. Aggregate results only.

name: per-unit bulk results
evidence: WithBulkUnitResults and BulkExecUnits; bounded owned uint64 Id/Affected_rows units, live insert/update/rollback/error/transport checks. No per-row error records or RETURNING contract.

name: extended type metadata
evidence: Opt-in WithExtendedMetadata; real UUID/INET4/INET6/JSON attributes, Describe and ColumnTypes, caching/DDL/reset and owned bounded parsing. MariaDB 12.3 exposes VECTOR as VARBINARY without a type-name attribute.

name: session-state observation
evidence: Opt-in WithSessionTracking and pinned InspectSession; bounded OK/terminator blocks and owned last-observed variables/schema, including legacy EOF, errors and reset generations.

name: clean connection reset/restoration
evidence: Opt-in WithSessionReset and pinned ResetSession; charset/role/schema/ordered params/InitSQL restoration, rollback, private-state cleanup, lazy statement generations, cancellation and retirement. Default checkout remains liveness-only.

name: server cursor fetch
evidence: WithServerCursors; ordinary database/sql.Rows over read-only COM_STMT_FETCH batches, metadata caching/legacy EOF, early close/reset and cancellation faults. Server materializes SELECT cursors; multiple result sets unsupported.

name: io.Reader prepared parameters
evidence: ExecStream and StreamParam; chunk-bounded one-shot upload, exact limits/empty/NULL/reader errors, live transport and transaction tests, cancellation phases and bounded allocation with materialization control. Server still bounds complete parameters.

name: progress callbacks
evidence: WithProgressReports and ExecWithProgress; owned validated reports, real ALTER COPY callbacks on all transport profiles, callback error/panic draining and server-error preservation; no report guarantee or global server-setting changes.

name: PARSEC authentication
evidence: Built-in parsec plugin; real MariaDB account succeeds, binary challenge/signature and malformed/work-factor unit checks.

name: interactive PAM authentication
evidence: Opt-in PAM dialogue policy, verified TLS/Unix transport, prompt/response budgets and cancellation; isolated real single/multiple-question and rejection fixtures. See docs/STAGE5_AUTHENTICATION.md.

name: Kerberos GSSAPI authentication
evidence: Explicit principal-pinned mutual authentication and optional native macOS/Linux provider, Kerberos-only credentials and bounded asynchronous cleanup; isolated real KDC/MariaDB tests. Windows SSPI/NTLM is not implemented.

name: transaction-aware CDC/GTID resume
evidence: no binlog consumer API; separate optional extension scope beyond database/sql

name: performance_schema instrumentation
evidence: Required real statement/thread/connection-attribute checks on isolated Linux MariaDB with performance_schema=ON. Shared Mac service stays OFF and reports a profile skip.

name: PAM/Kerberos services
evidence: Task-owned disposable PAM/MariaDB/KDC services, synthetic PAM credentials, real tickets and private caches/CA; fixture source/runtime provenance recorded. No host realm/PAM changes or production identity-system claim.
